intendedContent: Benign source-local contact/receiver luminance selection for an already approved clothed illustration; no violent or self-harm content requested.

actualToolArguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: exact source-local included contact luminance selection S2 for Sakiko CHAT VIOLET.

Input 1 is the personally inspected healthy S1 original color markup. Input 2 is the exact approved original mother, used ONLY to distinguish intentional white markup from naturally light room objects. Same 1536x1024 canvas, coordinates and scale. This is selection conversion, not a new illustration.

Convert ONLY the deliberately painted original contact/receiver selections in image 1 to white/soft-gray on pure black: the SHORT cushion receiving material touching the underside of her skirt/hip and the tiny real underhem seam, plus the complete small soft wood-floor receiver directly under/next to both original loafers. Preserve the real local perimeter and soft falloff without broadening it into an empty floor pool, regular ellipse or rectangle. Naturally bright linen elsewhere is unselected.

CRITICAL CONTACT BOUNDARY: keep the intentionally included VERY NARROW LOWEST ORIGINAL OUTSOLE AND HEEL BOTTOM CONTACT RIM white and physically connected to the adjacent white floor patch. It is only the actual 2–4 source-pixel lowest curved toe-to-heel contact band. Do not subtract a larger black shoe silhouette: that would create a thin black moat between receiver and original figure. Keep the true bottom-rim overlap selected, while shoe uppers, toe caps, full heel sides, socks and legs are black. Likewise keep only tiny actual skirt/linen contact-boundary overlap to close the seat seam. Fixed MAX(F,S) later draws the original RGB once; tiny source-local overlap is deliberate, not double compositing.

Everything else must be pure black: all hair/ribbons/head/face/neck/body/hands/clothes/skirt/bare knees/calf socks and shoe bodies outside that tiny bottom contact band, all distant bench/cushion/pillows/throw, lamp, curtain, windows/sunset/town/lake, table/cup/flowers/desk/plants/floor/rug. Compare input 2 so the bright original lamp or empty cream bench does not accidentally remain selected. No invented caster, extra figure, enlarging contact, recolor, moving or new material.

Output one opaque grayscale/luminance 1536x1024 PNG: only the intentional short cushion/contact island and complete localized soft floor receiver with the genuine narrow support-edge overlap white, natural gray antialias at its original outer boundaries, pure black elsewhere. No crop/shift/scale, outline, label, guide, text or new drawing.
